text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

OILSEED SALES - Egypt said Wednesday it had bought 5,000 tonnes of Singapore palm stearin at $504 per tonne C and F for March delivery. Egypt said it also bought 10,000 tonnes of Malaysia palm oil at $586.75 per tonne C and F for March delivery.
WHEAT SALES - Egypt's main commodities buyer said on Wednesday that he bought 400,000 tonnes of soft white Australian wheat about 10 days ago, a deal which the Australian Wheat Board denies.
WHEAT SALES - Mexico bought 50,000 tonnes U.S. hard red winter or spring wheat, seller's option, for March/April shipment, several U.S. exporters said.

WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC said it will tender February 18 for 20,500 tonnes of northern spring/dark northern spring wheat for donation to Mozambique. The wheat is for March 5-31 shipment and must have a minimum protein of 12.5 percent.

- Results are awaited on Iraq's tender for 50,000 tonnes U.S. hard red winter wheat under the U.N. Food for Oil deal, U.S. exporters said. Iraq seeks 25,000 tonnes for April shipment and 25,000 for May.

WHEAT TENDERS - Pakistan will hold two tenders simultaneously for 360,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat and Australian white milling wheat. Bids will be opened February 16 and must be valid on February 17. Shipment was for March 5-31.
- Lebanon's economy ministry invited international firms or their local agents to tender to buy on its behalf 35,000 tonnes of U.S. hard wheat for end of March.

- Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade has offered 40,000 tonnes of hard durum amber wheat for sale. February 12 was the final date for bids. Confirmation would be made on February 13.
SOYBEAN OIL - The CCC of USDA said it will tender February 11 for 11,670 tonnes of U.S. bulk crude degummed soybean oil for donation to Peru. Shipment is for March 20 to April 5.
CORN AND SOYBEAN TENDER - State-owned Taiwan Sugar Corp will tender Friday for 25,000 tonnes of U.S. corn and 5,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans for March shipment, local traders said on Wednesday.
CORN TENDER - Taiwan's FGEP corn-buying group will tender Thursday for 54,000 tonnes of U.S. corn, local traders said on Wednesday.
SOYMEAL TENDER - Korea Feed Association has invited tenders for 140,000 tonnes of soymeal by 0500 GMT Thursday. Traders said the KFA split the tenders into four positions for May/June shipment.

RICE TENDER - Colombia was to retender for up to 50,000 tonnes optional origin rice this week after passing last Friday, U.S. exporters said. One U.S. exporter said the rice could be U.S. or Argentine for March/April shipment. But one trader said the tender could be for 36,000 tonnes rough rice or 24,000 tonnes milled rice but it could also be for 50,000 tonnes optional origin rough or milled rice.

RICE TENDER - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs issued a tender to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for April shipment. March 3 was the final date to receive bids and confirmation would be March 12.

MARKET TALK - Korea Flour Mills Industrial Association said on Wednesday that wheat imports are expected to remain little changed in 1997 from 2,276,605 tonnes a year ago... The Philippines plans to import up to 650,000 tonnes of rice before the third quarter, when local rice production is low, a Philippine Agriculture Department official said...Major East Asian grain buyers said on Wednesday they are concerned about current long delays in Canadian wheat shipments and are monitoring the situation, but generally have no immediate plans to switch to other sources.
